title: FeaturePlanValidator
responsibility: Validate feature-plan schema, page option selection, module tree and task dependency graph before approval.

inputs.name: validate.plan
inputs.description: Candidate FeaturePlan parsed by the published strict planSchema.

inputs.name: validate.options
inputs.description: Drafts may omit selections; approval requires one selected existing option per page.

outputs.name: validate
outputs.description: Valid plans have unique page, option, change and task IDs; exactly one preferred option per page; selected options belong to the page; parent and prerequisite references exist without cycles; tasks belong to the feature, identify a planned module and include its wanted contract. Distinct independent branches are accepted. Every non-reuse change, including removal, requires a wanted contract; implementation tasks match the change contract and use a subset of its files; verification tasks may use their separately granted verification files.

errors.name: invalid plan
errors.description: Malformed schemas, duplicate IDs, missing or cyclic parent/dependency references, cross-feature tasks, absent wanted contracts and missing approval selections are rejected without mutation.
